name: Military Tech Labs: B-52 Stratofortress
summary:
Welcome to Military Tech Labs: B-52, an interactive aerospace learning experience centered on one of the world's most iconic military aircraft: the B-52 Stratofortress.

Unlike a flight simulator, Military Tech Labs: B-52 is a virtual technology museum where curiosity drives exploration. Walk around a full-scale B-52, examine a turbofan engine cutaway, explore the cockpit, and inspect the aircraft's weapons and components up close.
